description: Create a JSON list of friends who work for United Airlines. First, add two specific friends to your list to ensure data exists: 'Captain UAL' (Airline: United) and 'Captain DAL' (Airline: Delta). Then, scan your friends list and create a JSON file at '/sdcard/united_friends.json' containing ONLY the friends associated with United Airlines. The JSON should be a list of objects with 'name' and 'airline' fields. Exclude any friends from other airlines.
